caption_L1: Here a is a area chart labeled U.S. war costs in Iraq and Afghanistan from 2003 to 2015 (in billion U.S. dollars). Iraq is measured along the y-axis. Along the x-axis, Year is measured with a linear scale with a minimum of 2004 and a maximum of 2014.
caption_L2L3: According to the area graph illustrating US war costs in Iraq and Afghanistan between 2003 and 2015, costs peaked in 2008 and have been declining since. War costs for the US amounted to almost $150bn in 2008, climbing up from $50bn in 2003. By the mid 2010s war costs annually were well below $10bn.
